name: Head Avatar Modeling
definition: A method that combines parametric morphable face models (e.g., FLAME) with deformable 3D Gaussians, employing diffusion strategies and expression-aware deformation fields to disentangle rigid head poses from non-rigid facial movements.
summary: Head Avatar Modeling combines parametric FLAME models with 3D Gaussians to enable real-time, editable rendering of dynamic faces while solving topology challenges inherent in unstructured Gaussian splatting.
